sloka: मारुतस्य औरसः श्रीमान् हनुमान् नाम वानरः ।वज्र संहननोपेतो वैनतेय समः जवे ॥१-१७-१६॥
transliteration: mārutasya aurasaḥ śrīmān hanumān nāma vānaraḥ ।vajra saṁhananopeto vainateya samaḥ jave ॥1-17-16॥

translations.english: Thousands of warriors possessing immeasurable strength and courage and capable of assuming any form at will were created to kill Ravana.
translations.hindi: वह महाराज दशरथ की ओर देख कर यह्‌ बोला-- “महाराज ! मैं प्रजापति के पास से आया हूँ?
